# Vendored design tokens

`omnibioai-design-tokens` is vendored from
`OmniBioAI/omnibioai-design-tokens` commit
`32864277749fbf542994b2b380d123e3ff1fddb4` (package version `1.1.0`).
The snapshot is used as a local package so the UI and Docker build do not rely
on an unpublished private package registry version.
